verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI documents deferred tools that require user approval or run outside the agent's process, which gives per-tool gating. Its coding agent offers workspace-rooted file access and an allowlisted shell, a limited form of execution restriction. There is no evidence of a general sandboxed execution environment or a fine-grained permission policy system, and no independent corroboration. Missing for 10: an explicit sandboxed code/tool execution runtime, a documented fine-grained tool permission/policy model beyond approval gating, and hands-on corroboration.
